title: summary: integrate the timeline per process and per subtree
body: Pure. Per process and per subtree: wall alive, cpu total, mean and max concurrency, seconds at concurrency at or under the serial threshold (a flag, default near 1.2, never a constant), parallel work above it, and a histogram of seconds at each integer level. For a spawned root, the cpu the tree accounted for beside what wait4 rusage says the tree spent, so children that lived and died between ticks show as a number.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bee2f5ca
notes.text: Subtree figures went to tree.tbl, same columns as summary.tbl, and the histogram to levels.tbl (scope, pid, name, cpus, wall), rather than widening summary.tbl. Tree charged is the sum of members' final charged, not the last row's, since members die at different ticks.
